name: eslam-ramzy-portfolio
description: Personal portfolio platform — public site, admin dashboard, REST API

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @portfolio/shared && npm run dev --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w @portfolio/shared && npm run build -w @portfolio/api && npm run build -w @portfolio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @portfolio/shared && npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/api && npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @portfolio/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w @portfolio/shared && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
